text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Annual CO₂ emissions from aviation 2013 to 2024
Includes emissions from both domestic and international aviation. International aviation emissions are assigned
to the country of departure. CO₂ emissions from commercial passenger flights only.

tspan.tspan: Data on aviation emissions is missing for some countries, so actual global and regional emissions are higher. Regional emissions are

text.tspan: shown to highlight trends over time and should not be compared.
